basic_details.job_title: SPIESR Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Research Assistant, Field Investigators Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Sardar Patel Institute of Economic and Social Research (SPIESR), Ahmedabad is filling 3 temporary positions under its ICSSR-funded project (Grant OH-31) on the cost of school education in India: 1 Research Assistant (RA) at ₹37,000 per month and 2 Field Investigators (FIs) at ₹20,000 per month. Both posts need a postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. The Research Assistant must also have qualified NET or hold an M.Phil./Ph.D. degree. Candidates apply by emailing a detailed CV to [email protected] on or before 13 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice asks for applications by email only, on or before 13 November 2026.
Write the email subject line as "Application for Research Assistant (RA) / Field Investigator (FI), as applicable" – that is, name the post you are applying for.
Send the CV by email to [email protected] on or before 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About SPIESR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Sardar Patel Institute of Economic and Social Research (SPIESR) is a research institute in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The three posts serve its ICSSR-funded project (Grant OH-31) titled "The Cost of School Education in India: Trends in Schooling and Private Tuition Expenditure, Determinants, and Differences Across School Types". The notice describes the positions as temporary.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SPIESR has advertised 3 posts in total under the project. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both posts require a postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. The other conditions differ by post, as shown below. Postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Must have qualified NET or hold an M.Phil./Ph.D. degree. Working knowledge of SPSS/STATA is required. Familiarity with NSS unit-level data will be preferred. Postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Should be willing to undertake fieldwork and data-entry activities in different parts of Gujarat. Must have good communication skills in both English and Gujarati. The notice does not mention an age limit or a minimum experience for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SPIESR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications by email only, on or before 13 November 2026. Prepare a detailed CV. Write the email subject line as "Application for Research Assistant (RA) / Field Investigator (FI), as applicable" – that is, name the post you are applying for. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SPIESR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Research Assistant (RA) and 2 Field Investigators (FIs).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SPIESR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their CV on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the SPIESR Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, plus qualified NET or an M.Phil./Ph.D. degree, and working knowledge of SPSS/STATA. Familiarity with NSS unit-level data will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the SPIESR Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, good communication skills in both English and Gujarati, and willingness to undertake fieldwork and data-entry activities in different parts of Gujarat.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for SPIESR Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant gets ₹37,000 per month and each Field Investigator gets ₹20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for SPIESR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email a detailed CV to [email protected] on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for Research Assistant (RA) / Field Investigator (FI), as applicable", naming the post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q8. Are the SPIESR posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls them temporary positions under the ICSSR-funded project (Grant OH-31).

faq.question: Q9. Do Field Investigators have to travel?
faq.answer: Yes. Field Investigators should be willing to undertake fieldwork and data-entry activities in different parts of Gujarat.
